Raises per-share price to meet Nasdaq minimum bid and avoid delisting risk.
Sets a near-term catalyst window; expect volatility at the open.
Rounding up to one share can slightly alter share count and float.
Lower float can amplify price swings and spread changes.
Operational change for brokers/settlement; ticker remains UZX.

This appears as a late-stage step to address a low share price and maintain listing, common among micro-caps. A sustained bid above Nasdaq’s threshold and any operational or financial improvements would turn this into a more durable catalyst.
